_comment: Endpoint config for Approach A. NOTHING here is a real BBB endpoint --
the URL and headers below are placeholders. Fill them from your own
browser session, or let the tool do it:
1. Open bbb.org, run the search by hand with your category + location
2. DevTools > Network > filter XHR/Fetch, find the paginated JSON call
3. Right-click the request > 'Save all as HAR with content'
Add --save-cookies only if the endpoint needs them; cookies are session
credentials, so keep the generated file out of git (see .gitignore).
Multiple entries are tried in order until one returns business records.
